page_title: PAL 1-1 OSA | Las Palmas v Osasuna 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
90+3' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+3' Dangerous play by Saul Coco (Las Palmas). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Osasuna.
90+1' Here is a change. Ante Budimir is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Kike Barja (Osasuna).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) for Alex Suarez.
88' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) but poses no threat.
84' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
83' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for an infringement. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
82' The referee blows his whistle as Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Las Palmas.
81' The fouls committed statistics – 4:10.
80' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
79' Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Campana (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch so that Enzo Loiodice can be given a rest.
77' Marvin (Las Palmas) is substituted due to injury. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives a chance to Julian Araujo.
77' Marvin (Las Palmas) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
77' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
74' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replaces Moi Gomez.
74' Substitution. Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) on for Jesus Areso.
72' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
70' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner but it's cleared.

69' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' The attendance is 25075.

66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
65' Marc Cardona goes off the pitch and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on.
65' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) replacing Alberto Moleiro.
63' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Jon Moncayola and he is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
63' Substitution. Raul Garcia will be replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).

61' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
58' Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

52' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Sergio Herrera. 1:1.
49' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

49' 0 - 1 A good lofted pass from Johan Mojica finds Unai Garcia (Osasuna) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the top left corner. The score is now 0:1.
48' The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
48' The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+1' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
45+1' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' What was Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. Las Palmas earn a free kick.
42' Handball! A player from Las Palmas handled the ball.

39' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
35' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the right side of the target, but Sergio Herrera keeps it out with an amazing save.
31' Osasuna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Las Palmas.
25' The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) will deliver the corner kick.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
12' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) will take a corner kick.
11' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) steps up to send the ball in.
10' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Saul Coco (Las Palmas), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
9' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is about to take a corner kick.
8' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals NO PENALTY for Las Palmas after a VAR review!
7' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
7' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game.
5' A dangerous attempt from Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) was aimed to the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a superb save and stops the shot.
4' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) brought his opponent down. Las Palmas have a free kick.
